summary: This is an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 341,423 Class I common shares for $9.2 million total consideration, priced at NAV ($27.00/share) as of May 31, 2026, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. It also discloses NAV by class, aggregate NAV of ~$10.8 billion, portfolio fair value of ~$21.7 billion, debt of ~$11.2 billion, debt-to-equity ratio of 1.06x, and available borrowing capacity of ~$4.8 billion, along with declaration of regular monthly distributions for June through September 2026. No special situation is present; this is a routine capital raise and periodic NAV/distribution disclosure.
